integrity: Exact symbolic first-Lyapunov formula with an independently computed complex-eigenvector tensor check for the published and contrasting rational-payoff examples. Self-review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: Interior, planar, nondegenerate local Hopf classification only. Coefficient-zero cases require a higher-order normal form. No global cycle or basin result is asserted. General validity requires the stated q<0, p>0, positive beta and epsilon, and interior equilibrium; the beta-bifurcation statement additionally requires nonzero trace crossing.
title: A sharp Hopf-criticality law for bilinear logit–environment feedback games
